messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Continuous-batching latency cliff detected on us-west-2 cluster. 90th p90 token latency > 1.2s for last 3m, error rate +5%. Rule: cb-latency-threshold-trigger.
ryan_oncall: seeing it in dashboards. tail latency jumps correlate with concurrency spike ~350k rps.
maria_ml: looks like KV cache eviction rate spiked at the same time, TTL regen went up. could be cache churn.
sam_sre: confirmed. KV cache evictions/sec = 85k -> 250k around 09:12 UTC. microbatch size collapsed to 1 in telemetry during the spike.
leo_infra: any recent routing/rollout changes? I rolled a small kernel patch to batching executor at 09:05 but it was limited to canary nodes.
ryan_oncall: @leo_infra good catch. canary nodes show same pattern. @maria_ml do you think prefetch/coalescing regressed?
maria_ml: likely. We recently changed prefetch backoff heuristics yesterday. If prefetch stops coalescing, KV warms fail and microbatching starves -> heavy evictions.
sam_sre: mitigation plan: 1) reduce max concurrency for cb-router on us-west-2 to 60% 2) force microbatch target to 8 tokens 3) disable new prefetch backoff on canaries via k8s rollout pause.
ryan_oncall: doing (1) now: `kubectl scale --replicas=12 deploy/cb-router-usw2` -> throttling ingress at lb.
eng-runbook-bot: Runbook snippet: adjust batch config -> /runbooks/continuous-batch#temp-throttle
leo_infra: (2) apply hotpatch to executor config:
```
PATCH /configs/cb_executor
microbatch_target: 8
batch_timeout_ms: 12
```
Applying via ConfigMap update to deployment cb-executor-usw2.
sam_sre: (3) rolling pause on prefetch job: `kubectl rollout pause daemonset/prefetcher-usw2` -> paused.
ryan_oncall: ingress throttle applied, executor config patched, prefetch paused. monitoring...
maria_ml: early signals: eviction rate down to 110k/sec and p90 latency falling from 1.25s -> 420ms over 2m.
ryan_oncall: customer impact? any 5xxs?
sam_sre: small uptick in 502s during config change window ~09:17-09:19, but now baseline. Post-change 5xx down to normal. flagged support for customers with high-tail interactive workloads.
leo_infra: rolling back the kernel patch from canaries to be safe. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/batching-executor-canary`
ryan_oncall: handing off to @sam_sre for monitoring for the next hour. I'm OOO after 10:00 UTC but will check Slack.
sam_sre: taking over. will keep watch and escalate to infra if p90 re-elevates >700ms.
eng-runbook-bot: Incident severity: Sev2 (service degradation for subset of traffic). Suggested follow-up: postmortem, revert plan audit, add guardrail to prefetch backoff.
maria_ml: action items noted: 1) add metric for prefetch coalescing rate 2) add automated rollback if microbatch collapses <2 for >30s 3) verify KV TTL regens under load.
ryan_oncall: thanks team. tagging support: @support-team to contact any customers impacted during 09:10-09:25 UTC.
sam_sre: update 09:35 UTC: stable. I'll keep thread open for handoff summary and postmortem owner assignment.
leo_infra: will prepare kernel patch notes and canary rollout diffs.
eng-runbook-bot: Thread closed by sam_sre at 09:45 UTC — follow-up: assign to maria_ml for postmortem and to leo_infra for rollout checklist.
sam_sre: closing note: root cause likely interaction between new prefetch backoff and canary executor patch causing coalescing to break under high concurrency. Postmortem please include load-replay and config diff. :white_check_mark:
